mapper.sql: select sq.id, sq.laoren_id as laorenId, sq.jiashu_id as jiashuId, sq.jiashu_xingming as jiashuXingming, sq.laoren_xingming as laorenXingming, sq.yuan_lianxi_dianhua as yuanLianxiDianhua, sq.xin_lianxi_dianhua as xinLianxiDianhua, sq.yuan_jiating_zhuzhi as yuanJiatingZhuzhi, sq.xin_jiating_zhuzhi as xinJiatingZhuzhi, sq.yuan_touxiang as yuanTouxiang, sq.xin_touxiang as xinTouxiang, sq.yuan_beizhu as yuanBeizhu, sq.xin_beizhu as xinBeizhu, sq.xiugai_shuoming as xiugaiShuoming, sq.shenqing_zhuangtai as shenqingZhuangtai, sq.shenhe_ren_id as shenheRenId, sq.shenhe_ren_xingming as shenheRenXingming, sq.shenhe_shijian as shenheShijian, sq.shenhe_yijian as shenheYijian, sq.chuangjian_shijian as chuangjianShijian, sq.gengxin_shijian as gengxinShijian from laoren_xinxi_xiugai_shenqing sq
mapper.select:
where coalesce(sq.shanchu_zhuangtai, '正常') = '正常'
and sq.laoren_xingming like concat('%', #{laorenXingming}, '%')
and sq.jiashu_xingming like concat('%', #{jiashuXingming}, '%')
and sq.shenqing_zhuangtai = #{shenqingZhuangtai}
order by sq.id desc
select coalesce(xingming, denglu_zhanghao) from xitong_yonghu where id = #{id} limit 1
mapper.update: update laoren_xinxi_xiugai_shenqing set shenqing_zhuangtai = #{shenqingZhuangtai}, shenhe_ren_id = #{shenheRenId}, shenhe_ren_xingming = #{shenheRenXingming}, shenhe_shijian = now(), shenhe_yijian = #{shenheYijian} where id = #{id} and coalesce(shanchu_zhuangtai, '正常') = '正常'
